why: The Smart Registrar is one workflow: names, accounts, the hourly DNSSEC check, notices, deactivation and abuse suspension only work safely together. The first public name goes live only when the whole of it is proven.

gates.title: Storyboard reviewed
gates.pass: This board agreed, wording and design
gates.evidence: Board ZR-SR-001 reviewed by the owner and brought to revision B: every registrant under every parent (primary or alias, with a Migrate option and a required move when a parent is lost), suspensions follow the account to every parent, one name per account stated as our precaution until the Public Suffix List, and each parent kept at two years of registration as the list requires.

gates.title: Engine API defined
gates.pass: Endpoints, authentication and the connector Steward uses
gates.evidence: Engine API agreed by the owner: four surfaces, each with its own revocable key (registrants by OpenID Connect and personal tokens; Steward, entitlement events and the parent path by Ed25519-signed requests); Steward connects as one more registrar, scoped to entitled names; entitlement events ordered and reconciled hourly; the parent path sets one name’s state only; a change is done when every parent nameserver serves it.

gates.title: Hourly check proven
gates.pass: Check, notices, deactivation and restoration on test names

gates.title: Abuse and sign-up checks
gates.pass: Lists chosen, with licence terms; threat check at sign-up

gates.title: Privacy notice
gates.pass: Published, with a retention period for addresses and logs
gates.evidence: Privacy notice published at /registry/privacy, kept and versioned in the registry, with a retention period for every kind of information; updated the same day for certificates, free sites and status pages.

gates.title: Mail proven
gates.pass: Both nodes send and receive; every required readiness check passes; one node drained while the other carries all mail; whitelisting proven at sign-up

gates.title: Registrant PowerDNS-Admin
gates.pass: Single sign-on, each registrant seeing only their zones
gates.evidence: Promoted from the preview to live (8443) on 25 November: one sign-in with the registry account, each registrant seeing only their own zone, with the Your site, Web forwarding and status cards.

gates.title: Steward signing for subscribers
gates.pass: Sub seen, cover runs, lapse ends signing in order (DS removed first)

gates.title: Registry VMs at two sites
gates.pass: Built from the image, replaced, standby promoted

gates.title: eng.quest live
gates.pass: The first public name, signed and validating
